projects.title: AI-Stock Predictor
projects.description: Multi-model stock price prediction system using Bi-LSTM-GRU, Random Forest, and XGBoost with 30+ financial indicators.

projects.title: Music Genre Classifier
projects.description: CNN-based deep learning model classifying music into 10 genres from raw audio with 88.55% accuracy.

projects.title: AI Research System
projects.description: Multi-agent research automation system using LangChain, Groq, and Tavily for automated research workflows.

projects.title: Bank Churn AI Advisor
projects.description: XGBoost model (AUC 0.91) predicting bank customer churn, explained by SHAP. Uses Llama 3.1 via Groq to generate personalised retention strategies. Built with Streamlit.

projects.title: US Airlines Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: Streamlit NLP app analysing ~14,600 tweets across 6 US airlines. Combines VADER scoring, text feature engineering & visualisations via Sankey diagrams, radar charts, heatmaps & word clouds.

projects.title: Power BI Food Delivery Dashboard
projects.description: End-to-end business analytics dashboard built in Power BI for a food delivery app, covering order trends, revenue analytics, customer insights & operational KPIs.

projects.title: WB 2026 Assembly Election Analysis
projects.description: End-to-end data analytics pipeline for the 2026 West Bengal Assembly Election — scraping, cleaning, 12 statistical analyses, and an interactive dashboard covering 293 constituencies across 5 election cycles.

projects.title: Algorithmic Trading Backtester
projects.description: ML-driven trading strategy backtester using Gradient Boosting with Purged K-Fold CV, custom simulation engine, and look-ahead bias safeguards. Built with Pandas, Scikit-Learn & Streamlit.

projects.title: E-Commerce CLV Segmentation
projects.description: Intelligent analytics dashboard using ML to segment e-commerce customers into actionable groups like 'Premium Loyalists' and 'At-Risk Whales' based on Customer Lifetime Value analysis.
